name: Magic Circle
description: Rotating arcane rune circle on the ground plane with light pillars
preview_html:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html><head><meta charset="utf-8">
<style>*{margin:0;padding:0}body{background:#060410;overflow:hidden}canvas{display:block}</style>
</head><body>
<script src="../../vendor/three.min.js"></script>
<script>
(function(){
var W=innerWidth,H=innerHeight;
var renderer=new THREE.WebGLRenderer({antialias:true});
renderer.setSize(W,H);renderer.setClearColor(0x060410);
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);
var scene=new THREE.Scene();
var camera=new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(60,W/H,0.1,100);
camera.position.set(0,3,3);camera.lookAt(0,0,0);
var outerTorus=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(1.5,0.055,10,80),new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:0x9955ff}));
outerTorus.rotation.x=Math.PI/2;scene.add(outerTorus);
var innerTorus=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(1.0,0.04,8,64),new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:0xbb77ff,transparent:true,opacity:0.85}));
innerTorus.rotation.x=Math.PI/2;scene.add(innerTorus);
var innerTorus2=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.55,0.03,8,48),new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:0xdd99ff,transparent:true,opacity:0.7}));
innerTorus2.rotation.x=Math.PI/2;scene.add(innerTorus2);
var coreDisk=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CircleGeometry(0.25,32),new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:0xeeccff,transparent:true,opacity:0.6,side:THREE.DoubleSide}));
coreDisk.rotation.x=-Math.PI/2;coreDisk.position.y=0.01;scene.add(coreDisk);
var ringGroups=[];
[[0.35,0.022,0xee88ff],[0.7,-0.016,0xcc66ff],[1.05,0.012,0xaa44ff],[1.4,-0.009,0x8833ff]].forEach(function(cfg){var rN=24+cfg[0]*20,rpos=new Float32Array(Math.round(rN)*3);for(var i=0;i<Math.round(rN);i++){var a=(i/Math.round(rN))*Math.PI*2;rpos[i*3]=Math.cos(a)*cfg[0];rpos[i*3+1]=0.01;rpos[i*3+2]=Math.sin(a)*cfg[0];}
var rg=new THREE.BufferGeometry();rg.setAttribute('position',new THREE.BufferAttribute(rpos,3));
var rpts=new THREE.Points(rg,new THREE.PointsMaterial({color:cfg[2],size:0.07,transparent:true,opacity:0.8}));
scene.add(rpts);ringGroups.push({pts:rpts,speed:cfg[1]});});
var pillars=[];
for(var i=0;i<8;i++){var a=(i/8)*Math.PI*2,px=Math.cos(a)*1.5,pz=Math.sin(a)*1.5,ppos=new Float32Array(25*3);
for(var j=0;j<25;j++){ppos[j*3]=px;ppos[j*3+1]=(j/25)*2.2;ppos[j*3+2]=pz;}
var pg=new THREE.BufferGeometry();pg.setAttribute('position',new THREE.BufferAttribute(ppos,3));
var pmat=new THREE.PointsMaterial({color:0xcc88ff,size:0.055,transparent:true,opacity:0.55});
scene.add(new THREE.Points(pg,pmat));pillars.push({mat:pmat,phase:i*Math.PI/4});}
window.addEventListener('resize',function(){W=innerWidth;H=innerHeight;renderer.setSize(W,H);camera.aspect=W/H;camera.updateProjectionMatrix();});
var t=0;
function animate(){requestAnimationFrame(animate);t+=0.02;
  outerTorus.rotation.z+=0.006;innerTorus.rotation.z-=0.012;innerTorus2.rotation.z+=0.02;
  ringGroups.forEach(function(r){r.pts.rotation.y+=r.speed;});
  var pulse=0.92+0.08*Math.sin(t*2.2);outerTorus.scale.setScalar(pulse);innerTorus.scale.setScalar(pulse);
  coreDisk.scale.setScalar(1+0.3*Math.abs(Math.sin(t*3)));
  pillars.forEach(function(p){p.mat.opacity=0.35+0.45*Math.abs(Math.sin(t*2.8+p.phase));p.mat.color.setHSL(0.78+0.05*Math.sin(t+p.phase),1,0.65);});
  renderer.render(scene,camera);}
animate();})();
</script></body></html>
